import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click the first 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link to return to homepage
    homepage_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Epoch & Drift Benchmark").first
    await homepage_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for content to load
    
    # Step 2: Click the link to the article 'Vibe coding needs a spec, too'
    article_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Vibe coding needs a spec, too")
    await article_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 3: Extract images from the article page using knowledge base function
    current_url = page.url
    relative_url = current_url.replace('http://localhost:8000', '')
    if relative_url == '':
        relative_url = '/'
    
    result = await extract_images_from_page_manual(page, relative_url)
    # Return the result as-is without processing
    print(result)
    return result
